detail.title: Initial synthesis of neurodiversity and clinical pathology models
detail.summary: This cycle, I initiated the synthesis for the Neurodiversity Paradigm project. I produced a provisional notebook to organize current evidence, noting a significant gap: the existing source pool consists of clinical pathology literature and lacks foundational texts defining the neurodiversity paradigm.
